item.title: Bad timings on traffic lights located on Arle Court roundabout, 7th October
item.description:
I don’t know if it has been changed recently but all of the traffic lights around arle court roundabout, for instance the ones as you come off the golden valley onto the roundabout, are completely out of time. It’s causing a massive build up of traffic on the roundabout during rush hour in the evening as loads of cars end up blocking others or not being able to even get onto the roundabout without pushing. I’ve seen several accidents and several more near misses just within the last week or so
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Arle Court Roundabout, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: No signage to mark the end of a cycle path, 7th October
item.description:
This cycle path runs along Andover Road until it reaches Hatherley Street. The cycle path has been newly whitened two months ago. However, there is no sign to tell cyclists that this is the end of the cycle path. As a result, cyclists are continuing to cycle along Andover Road towards the junction with Lypiatt Street. Many people have experienced near misses and one resident has been hit by a cyclist, due to the absence of 'End of Cycle Lane' signs.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 72, Andover Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
